structured_output.summary: The change is coherent and well covered by the integration and unit tests. I found no blocking defect. My scratch probe could not be run: `aih check --probe` reported "no test classes to run" for a metadata-module test, so the probe entries below are unrun. I did not read the truncated part of the diff (`AbstractKafkaConfig`, `DynamicBrokerConfig`, `LogDirsCommand`, `LogDirsCommandTest`) and did not check how it validates dynamic `cordoned.log.dirs` values (ACC23).

findings.text: When every live directory is cordoned, nextLogDirs falls back to a cordoned directory, so ACC30 ('never picks a cordoned directory') only holds while an uncordoned live directory exists. The integration test asserts the fallback, so it is deliberate, but it deserves a comment or a KIP check.

No test checks that heartbeats omit CordonedLogDirs before the initial catch-up and include them afterwards. A BrokerLifecycleManager unit test, a KafkaConfig validation unit test for cordoned.log.dirs, and a LogManager unit test for nextLogDirs are also missing; only the integration tests exercise them.
DynamicCordonedLogDirs has an empty validateReconfiguration, and BrokerRegistration.sorted() duplicates the sorting done in the constructor and in handleCordonedDirectories. Both could be trimmed.

coverage.note: Rejection of invalid entries, setting multiple valid directories, and removal (uncordon) in testCordonedLogDirectoriesAreNotUsedForNewPartitions are all asserted.
Dynamic set on MV 4.2 is rejected with InvalidConfigurationException, and the static '*' has no effect.
The controller reflects a dynamic cordon and uncordon without a restart. ReplicationControlManagerTest.testHandleCordonedDirectoriesInHeartbeat covers the controller side of the heartbeat.
Auto placement avoids the cordoned broker, and waitForControllerToExcludeBroker asserts INVALID_REPLICATION_FACTOR.
Both createTopics and createPartitions with an explicit assignment return InvalidReplicaAssignmentException.
Reassignment onto the cordoned broker returns IneligibleReplicaException, and reassignment between other brokers still works.
AlterReplicaLogDirs to a cordoned directory fails with InvalidReplicaAssignmentException, and succeeds after uncordoning.
Four getOrCreateLog calls with the cordoned directory suggested all land in the uncordoned directory.
isCordoned() is asserted true for the cordoned directory and false for the other.
The count gauge and the per-directory gauges are checked through cordon, cordon-all and uncordon.
The embedded cluster cordons and uncordons through the Admin client, and the test checks where replicas land. The error cases are in the sibling tests of the same class.
